question: On eBay, what happens to items listed at a round $100 rather than at nearby precise prices?
options: No difference in offers or speed
answer: Lower offers, which arrive sooner. In millions of eBay bargaining exchanges, Backus, Blake and Tadelis found that items listed at multiples of $100 drew offers 5–8% lower but 6–11 days sooner, and were 3–5% likelier to sell. A round number reads as a seller in a hurry; house sales show the same pattern.
move: A round number invites haggling; a precise one says the sums are done.
trap: Assuming a few dollars either way cannot change how buyers bid.
source: Backus, Blake & Tadelis, J. Political Economy, 2019
